CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_guard_finance_user_signing_lifecycle()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_has_dependents boolean;
  v_has_capability boolean;
  v_has_frozen_pending_assignee boolean;
  v_verified_rebind boolean := false;
  v_google_email text;
begin
  select exists (
      select 1
      from public.employee_department_roles dependent
      where dependent.tenant_id = old.tenant_id
        and dependent.active = true
        and dependent.finance_user_id <> old.id
        and (
          dependent.direct_supervisor_finance_user_id = old.id
          or dependent.approval_delegate_finance_user_id = old.id
        )
    ),
    exists (
      select 1
      from public.employee_department_roles capability
      where capability.tenant_id = old.tenant_id
        and capability.finance_user_id = old.id
        and capability.active = true
        and capability.can_approve = true
    ),
    public.finance_user_has_frozen_pending_assignee(old.tenant_id, old.id)
  into
    v_has_dependents,
    v_has_capability,
    v_has_frozen_pending_assignee;

  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then
    if v_has_frozen_pending_assignee then
      raise exception 'Reassign frozen pending approval steps before deleting Finance user'
        using errcode = '23514';
    end if;
    if v_has_dependents then
      raise exception 'Reassign active supervisor/delegate routes before deleting Finance user'
        using errcode = '23514';
    end if;
    if exists (
      select 1
      from public.employee_department_roles historical_assignment
      where historical_assignment.tenant_id = old.tenant_id
        and historical_assignment.finance_user_id = old.id
    ) then
      raise exception 'Finance user has organization history; disable the person instead of deleting'
        using errcode = '23514';
    end if;
    return old;
  end if;

  if old.active = true
     and new.active is distinct from true
     and v_has_frozen_pending_assignee then
    raise exception 'Reassign frozen pending approval steps before disabling Finance user'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if old.active = true
     and new.active is distinct from true
     and v_has_dependents then
    raise exception 'Reassign active supervisor/delegate routes before disabling Finance user'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if old.active = true
     and new.active is distinct from true
     and not v_has_dependents then
    update public.employee_department_roles edr
    set
      active = false,
      can_approve = false,
      effective_to = case
        when edr.effective_from < current_date then current_date - 1
        else edr.effective_from
      end,
      metadata = coalesce(edr.metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
        || jsonb_build_object(
          'deactivated_with_finance_user_at', now(),
          'approval_eligible_after_reactivation', edr.can_approve
        ),
      updated_at = now()
    where edr.tenant_id = old.tenant_id
      and edr.finance_user_id = old.id
      and edr.active = true;
  end if;

  if old.active is distinct from true and new.active = true then
    update public.employee_department_roles edr
    set
      active = true,
      effective_to = null,
      can_approve = false,
      metadata = coalesce(edr.metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
        || jsonb_build_object(
          'reactivated_with_finance_user_at', now(),
          'approval_reactivation_requires_review', true
        ),
      updated_at = now()
    where not exists (
      select 1
      from public.employee_department_roles active_primary
      where active_primary.tenant_id = old.tenant_id
        and active_primary.finance_user_id = old.id
        and active_primary.is_primary = true
        and active_primary.active = true
    )
      and edr.id = (
        select candidate.id
        from public.employee_department_roles candidate
        where candidate.tenant_id = old.tenant_id
          and candidate.finance_user_id = old.id
          and candidate.is_primary = true
          and candidate.active = false
        order by candidate.updated_at desc nulls last,
          candidate.created_at desc nulls last,
          candidate.id
        limit 1
      );
  end if;

  if old.auth_user_id is distinct from new.auth_user_id
     or lower(old.email) is distinct from lower(new.email) then
    v_google_email := public.finance_verified_google_email(new.auth_user_id);
    v_verified_rebind := old.id = new.id
      and old.tenant_id = new.tenant_id
      and old.auth_user_id is not null
      and new.auth_user_id is not null
      and old.google_link_status = 'pending_rebind'
      and lower(btrim(coalesce(old.pending_login_email, ''))) = v_google_email
      and lower(btrim(new.email)) = v_google_email
      and new.google_link_status = 'bound'
      and new.pending_login_email is null
      and exists (
        select 1
        from private.finance_google_link_mutation_authorizations_v2 authz
        where authz.backend_pid = pg_catalog.pg_backend_pid()
          and authz.transaction_id = pg_catalog.txid_current()
          and authz.tenant_id = old.tenant_id
          and authz.finance_user_id = old.id
          and authz.action = 'verified_rebind'
          and authz.old_auth_user_id = old.auth_user_id
          and authz.new_auth_user_id = new.auth_user_id
          and authz.old_email = lower(btrim(old.email))
          and authz.new_email = v_google_email
          and authz.target_revision = new.google_link_revision
      );

    if old.auth_user_id is not null
       and v_has_frozen_pending_assignee
       and not v_verified_rebind then
      raise exception 'Reassign frozen pending approval steps before changing Google identity'
        using errcode = '23514';
    end if;

    if old.auth_user_id is not null
       and (v_has_dependents or v_has_capability)
       and not v_verified_rebind then
      raise exception 'Disable approval capability and reassign routes before changing Google identity'
        using errcode = '23514';
    end if;

    if v_verified_rebind then
      new.google_login_verified_at := coalesce(new.google_login_verified_at, now());
    else
      new.google_login_verified_at := null;
    end if;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_guard_verified_google_auth_binding()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_google_email text;
  v_verified_rebind boolean := false;
begin
  if new.auth_user_id is null then
    return new;
  end if;

  v_google_email := public.finance_verified_google_email(new.auth_user_id);

  if v_google_email is null
     or v_google_email <> lower(btrim(coalesce(new.email, ''))) then
    raise exception
      'Finance account binding requires an exact-email verified Google identity'
      using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and old.auth_user_id is distinct from new.auth_user_id then
    select (
      old.id = new.id
      and old.tenant_id = new.tenant_id
      and old.google_link_status = 'pending_rebind'
      and lower(btrim(coalesce(old.pending_login_email, ''))) = v_google_email
      and new.google_link_status = 'bound'
      and new.pending_login_email is null
      and exists (
        select 1
        from private.finance_google_link_mutation_authorizations_v2 authz
        where authz.backend_pid = pg_catalog.pg_backend_pid()
          and authz.transaction_id = pg_catalog.txid_current()
          and authz.tenant_id = old.tenant_id
          and authz.finance_user_id = old.id
          and authz.action = 'verified_rebind'
          and authz.old_auth_user_id = old.auth_user_id
          and authz.new_auth_user_id = new.auth_user_id
          and authz.old_email = lower(btrim(old.email))
          and authz.new_email = v_google_email
          and authz.target_revision = new.google_link_revision
          and authz.created_at >= clock_timestamp() - interval '5 minutes'
      )
    ) into v_verified_rebind;

    if old.auth_user_id is not null
       and lower(btrim(coalesce(old.email, ''))) <> v_google_email
       and not v_verified_rebind then
      raise exception
        'Finance account binding cannot rewrite a different pre-provisioned email'
        using errcode = '28000';
    end if;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_finance_user_to_tenant_member()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' then
    update public.tenant_members tm
    set active = false,
        updated_at = now()
    where tm.active = true
      and (
        tm.finance_user_id = old.id
        or (new.auth_user_id is not null and tm.auth_user_id = new.auth_user_id)
      )
      and (
        new.active = false
        or lower(coalesce(tm.email, '')) is distinct from lower(coalesce(new.email, ''))
        or tm.tenant_id is distinct from new.tenant_id
        or tm.auth_user_id is distinct from new.auth_user_id
        or tm.finance_user_id is distinct from new.id
      );
  end if;

  if new.active = true
     and coalesce(new.email, '') <> ''
     and new.auth_user_id is not null then
    insert into public.tenant_members (
      tenant_id,
      auth_user_id,
      finance_user_id,
      email,
      name,
      role,
      role_label,
      entity_id,
      department_code,
      active,
      updated_at
    )
    values (
      new.tenant_id,
      new.auth_user_id,
      new.id,
      lower(new.email),
      new.name,
      new.role,
      new.role_label,
      new.entity_id,
      new.department_code,
      true,
      now()
    )
    on conflict (tenant_id, (lower(email))) where active = true do update
    set auth_user_id = excluded.auth_user_id,
        finance_user_id = excluded.finance_user_id,
        name = excluded.name,
        role = excluded.role,
        role_label = excluded.role_label,
        entity_id = excluded.entity_id,
        department_code = excluded.department_code,
        active = true,
        updated_at = now();
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_google_email text;
  v_candidate_count integer;
  v_google_auth_count integer;
  v_finance public.finance_users%rowtype;
  v_previous_email text;
  v_previous_auth_user_id uuid;
  v_target_revision bigint;
  v_action text;
  v_authorization_id uuid;
  v_projection jsonb;
  v_health jsonb;
  v_error_code text;
  v_failure_status text;
begin
  if p_auth_user_id is null then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', false,
      'status', 'blocked',
      'status_label', '無法完成登入連結',
      'message', '尚未取得有效的 Google 登入工作階段。',
      'next_action', '請重新使用公司 Google 主帳號登入。'
    );
  end if;

  v_google_email := public.finance_verified_google_email(p_auth_user_id);
  if v_google_email is null then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', false,
      'status', 'blocked',
      'status_label', 'Google 身分尚未驗證',
      'message', '系統未取得相同信箱的已驗證公司 Google 身分。',
      'next_action', '請確認使用 Google Workspace 主帳號，不要使用別名信箱。'
    );
  end if;

  if nullif(private.finance_google_normalized_email_v2(p_requested_email), '') is not null
     and private.finance_google_normalized_email_v2(p_requested_email) <> v_google_email then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', false,
      'status', 'conflict',
      'status_label', 'Google 帳號不一致',
      'message', 'Google 回傳的主信箱與本次指定信箱不同。',
      'google_identity_email', v_google_email,
      'next_action', '請重新選擇正確的公司 Google 主帳號。'
    );
  end if;

  select count(distinct identity.user_id)::integer
  into v_google_auth_count
  from auth.identities identity
  join auth.users auth_user on auth_user.id = identity.user_id
  where identity.provider = 'google'
    and lower(coalesce(identity.identity_data ->> 'email_verified', 'false')) in ('true', '1')
    and lower(btrim(coalesce(identity.identity_data ->> 'email', ''))) = v_google_email
    -- GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_PRIMARY_EMAIL_RENAME_V1: auth.users.email may retain the pre-rename address.
    and auth_user.deleted_at is null;

  if v_google_auth_count <> 1 then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', false,
      'status', 'conflict',
      'status_label', 'Google 身分發生衝突',
      'message', '同一個已驗證 Google 信箱對應到非唯一 Auth 身分，系統已停止自動連結。',
      'google_identity_email', v_google_email,
      'conflict_count', v_google_auth_count,
      'next_action', '請由系統管理員確認 Supabase Auth 身分後再重試。'
    );
  end if;

  select count(*)::integer
  into v_candidate_count
  from public.finance_users fu
  where fu.active = true
    and (p_tenant_id is null or fu.tenant_id = p_tenant_id)
    and (
      (
        fu.auth_user_id = p_auth_user_id
        and lower(btrim(fu.email)) = v_google_email
        and fu.google_link_status in ('bound', 'pending_rebind')
      )
      or (
        fu.auth_user_id is null
        and lower(btrim(fu.email)) = v_google_email
        and fu.google_link_status = 'pending_first_login'
      )
      or (
        fu.auth_user_id is not null
        and lower(btrim(coalesce(fu.pending_login_email, ''))) = v_google_email
        and fu.google_link_status = 'pending_rebind'
      )
    );

  if v_candidate_count <> 1 then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', false,
      'status', 'conflict',
      'status_label', '找不到唯一的人員帳號',
      'message', case
        when v_candidate_count = 0 then 'Google 帳號尚未由人資建立或申請換綁。'
        else 'Google 帳號同時符合多筆人員帳號，系統已停止自動連結。'
      end,
      'google_identity_email', v_google_email,
      'candidate_count', v_candidate_count,
      'next_action', '請由執行長、行政主任或人資檢查人員管理的登入信箱。'
    );
  end if;

  select fu.*
  into v_finance
  from public.finance_users fu
  where fu.active = true
    and (p_tenant_id is null or fu.tenant_id = p_tenant_id)
    and (
      (
        fu.auth_user_id = p_auth_user_id
        and lower(btrim(fu.email)) = v_google_email
        and fu.google_link_status in ('bound', 'pending_rebind')
      )
      or (
        fu.auth_user_id is null
        and lower(btrim(fu.email)) = v_google_email
        and fu.google_link_status = 'pending_first_login'
      )
      or (
        fu.auth_user_id is not null
        and lower(btrim(coalesce(fu.pending_login_email, ''))) = v_google_email
        and fu.google_link_status = 'pending_rebind'
      )
    )
  for update;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.finance_users other
    where other.id <> v_finance.id
      and other.active = true
      and (
        other.auth_user_id = p_auth_user_id
        or lower(btrim(other.email)) = v_google_email
        or lower(btrim(coalesce(other.pending_login_email, ''))) = v_google_email
      )
  ) then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', false,
      'status', 'conflict',
      'status_label', '登入信箱已被占用',
      'message', '另一筆啟用中的人員帳號已使用或保留這個 Google 信箱。',
      'finance_user_id', v_finance.id,
      'current_login_email', v_finance.email,
      'pending_login_email', v_finance.pending_login_email,
      'revision', v_finance.google_link_revision,
      'next_action', '請由人資先解除重複登入信箱。'
    );
  end if;

  -- A rebind request never disables or mutates the old verified login.  The
  -- old account may keep entering the system while the replacement identity
  -- is pending, but it must not clear the pending request or bump revision.
  if v_finance.auth_user_id = p_auth_user_id
     and lower(btrim(v_finance.email)) = v_google_email
     and v_finance.google_link_status = 'pending_rebind' then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', true,
      'can_enter', true,
      'status', 'pending_rebind',
      'status_label', '等待新 Google 帳號完成換綁',
      'message', '原 Google 帳號仍可使用；系統會保留換綁申請，直到新帳號驗證完成。',
      'finance_user_id', v_finance.id,
      'current_login_email', v_finance.email,
      'pending_login_email', v_finance.pending_login_email,
      'auth_user_id', v_finance.auth_user_id,
      'revision', v_finance.google_link_revision,
      'old_login_still_active', true,
      'next_action', '請使用新的公司 Google 主帳號登入一次以完成換綁。'
    );
  end if;

  if v_finance.auth_user_id = p_auth_user_id
     and lower(btrim(v_finance.email)) = v_google_email
     and v_finance.google_link_status = 'bound' then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', true,
      'can_enter', true,
      'status', 'bound',
      'status_label', '已可使用 Google 登入',
      'message', '目前 Google 主帳號已完成正式連結。',
      'finance_user_id', v_finance.id,
      'current_login_email', v_finance.email,
      'pending_login_email', null,
      'auth_user_id', v_finance.auth_user_id,
      'revision', v_finance.google_link_revision,
      'old_login_still_active', true,
      'next_action', '可以直接進入會計系統。'
    );
  end if;

  v_previous_email := lower(btrim(v_finance.email));
  v_previous_auth_user_id := v_finance.auth_user_id;
  v_target_revision := v_finance.google_link_revision + 1;
  v_action := case
    when v_previous_auth_user_id is null
     and v_finance.google_link_status = 'pending_first_login'
     and v_previous_email = v_google_email
      then 'verified_first_bind'
    when v_previous_auth_user_id is not null
     and v_finance.google_link_status = 'pending_rebind'
     and lower(btrim(coalesce(v_finance.pending_login_email, ''))) = v_google_email
      then 'verified_rebind'
    else null
  end;

  if v_action is null then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', false,
      'status', 'blocked',
      'status_label', '尚未核准換綁',
      'message', '管理者尚未為這個 Google 主信箱建立換綁請求。',
      'finance_user_id', v_finance.id,
      'current_login_email', v_finance.email,
      'pending_login_email', v_finance.pending_login_email,
      'revision', v_finance.google_link_revision,
      'next_action', '請由執行長、行政主任或人資先在人員管理提出換綁。'
    );
  end if;

  begin
    v_authorization_id := private.finance_google_authorize_mutation_v2(
      v_finance.tenant_id,
      v_finance.id,
      v_action,
      v_previous_email,
      v_google_email,
      v_previous_auth_user_id,
      p_auth_user_id,
      v_target_revision,
      p_auth_user_id
    );

    update public.finance_users fu
    set
      email = v_google_email,
      auth_user_id = p_auth_user_id,
      logging_identity_id = p_auth_user_id::text,
      google_link_status = 'bound',
      pending_login_email = null,
      google_link_revision = v_target_revision,
      google_link_status_detail = '已完成相同主信箱的 Google 身分驗證與正式連結。',
      google_login_verified_at = now(),
      google_last_linked_at = now()
    where fu.tenant_id = v_finance.tenant_id
      and fu.id = v_finance.id
      and fu.google_link_revision = v_finance.google_link_revision;

    if not found then
      raise exception 'Google link revision changed during finalization'
        using errcode = '40001';
    end if;

    v_projection := private.finance_sync_google_link_projections_v2(
      v_finance.tenant_id,
      v_finance.id,
      p_auth_user_id,
      v_previous_email,
      v_google_email
    );

    perform public.finance_activate_verified_google_org_user(
      v_finance.tenant_id,
      v_finance.id,
      p_auth_user_id
    );

    v_health := private.finance_google_projection_health_v2(
      v_finance.tenant_id,
      v_finance.id
    );

    if coalesce((v_health ->> 'ok')::boolean, false) is not true then
      raise exception 'Google account projections did not converge'
        using errcode = '23514';
    end if;

    delete from private.finance_google_link_mutation_authorizations_v2
    where id = v_authorization_id;
  exception
    when others then
      get stacked diagnostics v_error_code = returned_sqlstate;

      -- If Google changed the primary email on the same Auth UUID, accepting
      -- the identity update while Finance stayed on the old canonical email
      -- would invalidate the only live login.  Inside the identity trigger,
      -- rethrow so GoTrue and every projection roll back together.
      if v_action = 'verified_rebind'
         and v_previous_auth_user_id = p_auth_user_id
         and pg_catalog.pg_trigger_depth() > 0 then
        raise;
      end if;

      -- Keep the retryable state and the old canonical binding intact.  A
      -- failed projection must never consume a pending first-login/rebind.
      v_failure_status := v_finance.google_link_status;
      v_target_revision := v_finance.google_link_revision;
      v_authorization_id := private.finance_google_authorize_mutation_v2(
        v_finance.tenant_id,
        v_finance.id,
        'projection_repair',
        v_previous_email,
        v_previous_email,
        v_previous_auth_user_id,
        v_previous_auth_user_id,
        v_target_revision,
        p_auth_user_id
      );

      update public.finance_users fu
      set
        google_link_status_detail =
          'Google 身分已驗證，但正式投影尚未完整同步，可安全重試：'
          || left(v_error_code, 12)
      where fu.tenant_id = v_finance.tenant_id
        and fu.id = v_finance.id;

      delete from private.finance_google_link_mutation_authorizations_v2
      where id = v_authorization_id;

      perform private.finance_google_write_diagnostic_v2(
        v_finance.tenant_id,
        v_finance.id,
        p_auth_user_id,
        'account_link_retry',
        v_failure_status,
        left(coalesce(v_error_code, 'unknown_error'), 80),
        coalesce(v_finance.pending_login_email, v_finance.email),
        v_google_email,
        null,
        jsonb_build_object(
          'phase', 'atomic_finalizer',
          'sqlstate', left(coalesce(v_error_code, 'unknown'), 12)
        ),
        p_auth_user_id
      );

      return jsonb_build_object(
        'ok', false,
        'status', v_failure_status,
        'status_label', case
          when v_failure_status = 'pending_rebind' then '等待新 Google 帳號換綁'
          else '等待首次 Google 登入'
        end,
        'message', 'Google 身分已驗證，但正式帳號投影尚未完整同步；原狀態已保留，可重新嘗試。',
        'finance_user_id', v_finance.id,
        'current_login_email', v_previous_email,
        'pending_login_email', v_finance.pending_login_email,
        'auth_user_id', v_previous_auth_user_id,
        'revision', v_target_revision,
        'error_code', v_error_code,
        'next_action', '請由系統管理員查看帳號連結狀態後重試。'
      );
  end;

  perform private.finance_google_write_diagnostic_v2(
    v_finance.tenant_id,
    v_finance.id,
    p_auth_user_id,
    'bound',
    'bound',
    null,
    v_google_email,
    v_google_email,
    null,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'phase', 'atomic_finalizer',
      'rebind', v_action = 'verified_rebind'
    ),
    p_auth_user_id
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'status', 'bound',
    'status_label', '已可使用 Google 登入',
    'message', 'Google 主帳號已完成驗證，前後台帳號與人員投影已同步。',
    'finance_user_id', v_finance.id,
    'current_login_email', v_google_email,
    'pending_login_email', null,
    'auth_user_id', p_auth_user_id,
    'revision', v_target_revision,
    'google_identity_email', v_google_email,
    'projection_health', v_health,
    'next_action', '可以直接進入會計系統。'
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.finance_sync_google_link_projections_v2(p_tenant_id uuid, p_finance_user_id text, p_auth_user_id uuid, p_previous_email text, p_new_email text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_finance public.finance_users%rowtype;
  v_company_id uuid;
  v_branch_id uuid;
  v_department_id uuid;
  v_position_id uuid;
  v_employee_id uuid;
  v_portal_user_id uuid;
  v_role_id uuid;
  v_email text := private.finance_google_normalized_email_v2(p_new_email);
  v_previous_email text := private.finance_google_normalized_email_v2(p_previous_email);
  v_portal_duplicate_count integer := 0;
  v_employee_count integer := 0;
begin
  select fu.*
  into v_finance
  from public.finance_users fu
  where fu.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    and fu.id = p_finance_user_id
  for update;

  if v_finance.id is null then
    raise exception 'Finance user is unavailable for Google projection sync'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  if v_email = '' or v_email <> lower(btrim(v_finance.email)) then
    raise exception 'Google projection email must match the canonical Finance email'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  select c.id
  into v_company_id
  from public.companies c
  where c.code = v_finance.entity_id
  order by c.created_at asc, c.id
  limit 1;

  if v_company_id is null then
    raise exception 'Cannot resolve the HR company for Finance user %', v_finance.id
      using errcode = '23503';
  end if;

  select b.id
  into v_branch_id
  from public.branches b
  where b.company_id = v_company_id
    and b.deleted_at is null
  order by b.created_at asc, b.id
  limit 1;

  select d.id
  into v_department_id
  from public.departments d
  where d.company_id = v_company_id
    and d.code = v_finance.department_code
  order by (d.deleted_at is null) desc, d.created_at asc, d.id
  limit 1;

  select p.id
  into v_position_id
  from public.positions p
  where p.company_id = v_company_id
    and p.code = coalesce(nullif(v_finance.role, ''), 'employee')
  order by (p.deleted_at is null) desc, p.created_at asc, p.id
  limit 1;

  insert into public.employees (
    company_id,
    primary_branch_id,
    primary_department_id,
    position_id,
    employee_no,
    full_name,
    preferred_name,
    email,
    employment_status,
    metadata,
    updated_at,
    deleted_at
  )
  values (
    v_company_id,
    v_branch_id,
    v_department_id,
    v_position_id,
    v_finance.id,
    v_finance.name,
    v_finance.name,
    v_email,
    case when v_finance.active then 'active' else 'terminated' end,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'finance_user_id', v_finance.id,
      'finance_role', v_finance.role
    ),
    now(),
    case when v_finance.active then null else now() end
  )
  on conflict (company_id, employee_no) do update
  set
    primary_branch_id = excluded.primary_branch_id,
    primary_department_id = excluded.primary_department_id,
    position_id = excluded.position_id,
    full_name = excluded.full_name,
    preferred_name = excluded.preferred_name,
    email = excluded.email,
    employment_status = excluded.employment_status,
    metadata = coalesce(public.employees.metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
      || excluded.metadata,
    updated_at = now(),
    deleted_at = excluded.deleted_at
  returning id into v_employee_id;

  update public.employees e
  set
    email = v_email,
    full_name = v_finance.name,
    preferred_name = coalesce(e.preferred_name, v_finance.name),
    employment_status = case when v_finance.active then 'active' else 'terminated' end,
    metadata = coalesce(e.metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
      || jsonb_build_object(
        'finance_user_id', v_finance.id,
        'finance_role', v_finance.role,
        'google_login_projection_synced_at', now()
      ),
    updated_at = now(),
    deleted_at = case when v_finance.active then null else coalesce(e.deleted_at, now()) end
  where e.employee_no = v_finance.id
     or e.metadata ->> 'finance_user_id' = v_finance.id;

  select count(*)::integer
  into v_employee_count
  from public.employees e
  where e.employee_no = v_finance.id
     or e.metadata ->> 'finance_user_id' = v_finance.id;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.users u
    where lower(btrim(u.email)) = v_email
      and (
        u.employee_id is null
        or not exists (
          select 1
          from public.employees e
          where e.id = u.employee_id
            and (
              e.employee_no = v_finance.id
              or e.metadata ->> 'finance_user_id' = v_finance.id
            )
        )
      )
  ) then
    raise exception 'The requested Google email belongs to another portal user'
      using errcode = '23505';
  end if;

  select u.id
  into v_portal_user_id
  from public.users u
  join public.employees e on e.id = u.employee_id
  where e.employee_no = v_finance.id
     or e.metadata ->> 'finance_user_id' = v_finance.id
  order by
    (lower(btrim(u.email)) = v_email) desc,
    (u.status = 'active') desc,
    u.created_at asc,
    u.id
  limit 1;

  select r.id
  into v_role_id
  from public.roles r
  where r.company_id is null
    and r.key = coalesce(nullif(v_finance.role, ''), 'employee')
  order by r.created_at asc nulls last, r.id
  limit 1;

  if v_portal_user_id is null then
    insert into public.users (
      auth_user_id,
      company_id,
      employee_id,
      role_id,
      email,
      display_name,
      status,
      updated_at,
      deleted_at
    )
    values (
      p_auth_user_id,
      v_company_id,
      v_employee_id,
      v_role_id,
      v_email,
      v_finance.name,
      case when v_finance.active then 'active' else 'disabled' end,
      now(),
      case when v_finance.active then null else now() end
    )
    returning id into v_portal_user_id;
  else
    update public.users u
    set
      auth_user_id = null,
      status = 'disabled',
      deleted_at = coalesce(u.deleted_at, now()),
      updated_at = now()
    where u.id <> v_portal_user_id
      and u.employee_id in (
        select e.id
        from public.employees e
        where e.employee_no = v_finance.id
           or e.metadata ->> 'finance_user_id' = v_finance.id
      );

    update public.users u
    set
      auth_user_id = p_auth_user_id,
      company_id = v_company_id,
      employee_id = v_employee_id,
      role_id = v_role_id,
      email = v_email,
      display_name = v_finance.name,
      status = case when v_finance.active then 'active' else 'disabled' end,
      deleted_at = case when v_finance.active then null else coalesce(u.deleted_at, now()) end,
      updated_at = now()
    where u.id = v_portal_user_id;
  end if;

  select count(*)::integer
  into v_portal_duplicate_count
  from public.users u
  where u.status = 'active'
    and u.employee_id in (
      select e.id
      from public.employees e
      where e.employee_no = v_finance.id
         or e.metadata ->> 'finance_user_id' = v_finance.id
    );

  update public.employee_department_roles edr
  set
    metadata = coalesce(edr.metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
      || jsonb_build_object(
        'contact_email', v_email,
        'source_payload',
          coalesce(edr.metadata -> 'source_payload', '{}'::jsonb)
          || jsonb_build_object(
            'userEmail', v_email,
            'contactEmail', v_email
          ),
        'google_login_projection_synced_at', now()
      ),
    updated_at = now()
  where edr.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    and edr.finance_user_id = v_finance.id
    and edr.active = true;

  update public.system_settings ss
  set
    value = private.finance_google_replace_projection_email_v2(
      ss.value,
      v_finance.id,
      v_finance.name,
      v_previous_email,
      v_email
    ),
    setting_value = private.finance_google_replace_projection_email_v2(
      ss.setting_value,
      v_finance.id,
      v_finance.name,
      v_previous_email,
      v_email
    ),
    settings = private.finance_google_replace_projection_email_v2(
      ss.settings,
      v_finance.id,
      v_finance.name,
      v_previous_email,
      v_email
    ),
    updated_by = 'finance_google_oauth_account_linkage_v2',
    updated_at = now()
  where ss.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    and ss.key in ('organization_chart', 'pptx_organization_roster')
    and (
      ss.value::text like '%' || v_finance.id || '%'
      or position(v_finance.name in ss.value::text) > 0
      or ss.setting_value::text like '%' || v_finance.id || '%'
      or ss.settings::text like '%' || v_finance.id || '%'
    );

  update public.tenant_members tm
  set
    active = false,
    updated_at = now()
  where tm.tenant_id = p_tenant_id

      v_finance.id,
      v_email,
      v_finance.name,
      v_finance.role,

    )

      data_scope_snapshot,

      finance_role,
      data_scope,

    )
    values (

      p_auth_user_id::text,

        'role', v_finance.role,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.finance_edoc_enqueue_event_v1(p_tenant_id uuid, p_aggregate_type text, p_aggregate_id text, p_source_revision bigint)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_event_id uuid;
  v_event_type text;
begin
  if p_aggregate_type not in ('member', 'company')
     or nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p_aggregate_id), '') is null
     or p_source_revision is null
     or p_source_revision <= 0 then
    raise exception 'Invalid Finance -> eDoc outbox aggregate'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  v_event_type := p_aggregate_type || '.changed';

  insert into private.finance_edoc_sync_outbox_v1 (
    tenant_id,
    aggregate_type,
    aggregate_id,
    event_type,
    source_revision
  )
  values (
    p_tenant_id,
    p_aggregate_type,
    pg_catalog.btrim(p_aggregate_id),
    v_event_type,
    p_source_revision
  )
  on conflict (tenant_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, source_revision)
    do nothing
  returning id into v_event_id;

  if v_event_id is null then
    select event_row.id
    into v_event_id
    from private.finance_edoc_sync_outbox_v1 event_row
    where event_row.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
      and event_row.aggregate_type = p_aggregate_type
      and event_row.aggregate_id = pg_catalog.btrim(p_aggregate_id)
      and event_row.source_revision = p_source_revision;
  end if;

  return v_event_id;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.finance_expense_guard_direct_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_tenant_id uuid;
  v_actor public.finance_users%rowtype;
  v_active_index int;
  v_active_step jsonb;
  v_role_key text;
  v_derived_status jsonb;
  v_permission_context jsonb;
  v_allowed_columns text[];
  v_allowed_payload_keys text[];
  v_reserved_payload_key text;
  v_write_context text := coalesce(
    pg_catalog.current_setting(
      'app.finance_expense_write_context',
      true
    ),
    ''
  );
begin
  if session_user in (
    'postgres',
    'supabase_admin'
  )
     or coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'role', '') = 'service_role' then
    return new;
  end if;

  -- A transaction-local marker is set only inside guarded database RPCs.
  -- PostgREST does not expose pg_catalog.set_config as a public endpoint.
  if v_write_context in (
    'active_step',
    'finalize',
    'advance_disbursement',
    'shareholder_posting',
    'org_resubmit',
    'offboarding_transfer'
  ) then
    return new;
  end if;

  if old.tenant_id is distinct from new.tenant_id
     or old.id is distinct from new.id
     or old.data_environment is distinct from new.data_environment
     or old.applicant_id is distinct from new.applicant_id
     or old.entity_id is distinct from new.entity_id
     or old.department_code is distinct from new.department_code
     or old.type is distinct from new.type then
    raise exception '申請單識別、租戶或歸屬資料不可直接變更'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  -- Default deny: only a timestamp-only update bypasses workflow validation.
  -- Future columns are protected automatically instead of silently falling
  -- through an outdated protected-column list.
  if (
    pg_catalog.to_jsonb(new) - array['updated_at']::text[]
  ) = (
    pg_catalog.to_jsonb(old) - array['updated_at']::text[]
  ) then
    return new;
  end if;

  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception '申請單關卡與會計欄位只能透過受控功能修改'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  v_tenant_id := public.current_tenant_id();
  if old.tenant_id <> v_tenant_id then
    raise exception '不可修改其他租戶的申請單'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  select finance_user.*
    into v_actor
  from public.finance_users finance_user
  where finance_user.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
    and finance_user.auth_user_id = auth.uid()
    and finance_user.active is true
  order by finance_user.created_at, finance_user.id
  limit 1;

  if not found then
    raise exception '目前登入帳號沒有有效財務人員身分'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  v_active_index :=
    private.finance_income_active_step_index(old.steps);
  if v_active_index is null then
    raise exception '已完成的申請單不可直接變更'
      using errcode = '55000';
  end if;

  v_active_step := old.steps -> v_active_index;
  v_role_key := private.finance_income_step_role(v_active_step);

  -- The legacy applicant-revision fallback is intentionally narrow: it can
  -- approve only its own frozen applicant_revision step and update submitted
  -- form/evidence payload.  It cannot change accounting/cash/identity fields.
  if v_role_key = 'applicant_revision'
     and v_actor.id = old.applicant_id
     and private.finance_expense_is_exact_step_transition(
       old.steps,
       new.steps,
       v_active_index,
       'approved',
       v_actor.id,
       v_actor.name
     )
     and private.finance_expense_new_files_are_owned(
       v_tenant_id,
       old,
       v_active_step -> 'files',
       new.steps -> v_active_index -> 'files',
       v_actor.id
     )
     and private.finance_expense_new_files_are_owned(
       v_tenant_id,
       old,
       old.actual_files,
       new.actual_files,
       v_actor.id
     ) then
    v_derived_status :=
      private.finance_income_status_from_steps(new.steps);
    if new.status <> v_derived_status ->> 'approval_status'
       or new.step <> (v_derived_status ->> 'approval_step')::int then
      raise exception '補件重送的下一關狀態不一致'
        using errcode = '23514';
    end if;
    if v_derived_status ->> 'approval_status' = 'completed' then
      raise exception
        '補件重送不得直接完成申請；請改走交易式最終簽核或入帳功能'
        using errcode = '55000';
    end if;

    v_allowed_columns := array[
      'status',
      'step',
      'steps',
      'form_payload',
      'actual_files',
      'ver',
      'updated_at'
    ];
    if (pg_catalog.to_jsonb(new) - v_allowed_columns) <>
       (pg_catalog.to_jsonb(old) - v_allowed_columns) then
      raise exception '補件重送不得改寫會計、金流或歸屬欄位'
        using errcode = '42501';
    end if;

    for v_reserved_payload_key in
      select payload_key
      from (
        select pg_catalog.jsonb_object_keys(
          coalesce(old.form_payload, '{}'::jsonb)
        ) as payload_key
        union
        select pg_catalog.jsonb_object_keys(
          coalesce(new.form_payload, '{}'::jsonb)
        )
      ) reserved_candidate
      where reserved_candidate.payload_key ~* (
        '^(advanceDisbursement|advanceOriginalAmount|' ||
        'advanceAccounting|shareholderPosted|' ||
        'shareholderVoucher|ledger|posting|cashPosted|' ||
        'voucher(Id|No)|accounting(Line|Approved|Posted|Locked)|' ||
        'flowStopped|cancelled)'
      )
    loop
      if (
           coalesce(old.form_payload, '{}'::jsonb) ?
             v_reserved_payload_key
         ) is distinct from (
           coalesce(new.form_payload, '{}'::jsonb) ?
             v_reserved_payload_key
         )
         or (
           coalesce(old.form_payload, '{}'::jsonb) ->
             v_reserved_payload_key
         ) is distinct from (
           coalesce(new.form_payload, '{}'::jsonb) ->
             v_reserved_payload_key
         ) then
        raise exception
          '補件重送不得新增、刪除或修改系統入帳與稽核欄位：%',
          v_reserved_payload_key
          using errcode = '42501';
      end if;
    end loop;

    new.ver := coalesce(old.ver, 1) + 1;
    new.updated_at := pg_catalog.now();
    return new;
  end if;

  -- Procurement payment/receipt are field-submit gates rather than general
  -- approvals.  Preserve them only as exact single-step transitions with
  -- explicit assignee + current Membership permission.
  if v_role_key in (
       'procurement_payment',
       'procurement_receipt',
       'procurement_review'
     )
     and private.finance_expense_actor_can_act(
       v_tenant_id,
       old,
       v_active_index,
       v_active_step,
       v_actor.id,
       v_actor.email,
       v_actor.role
     )
     and private.finance_expense_is_exact_step_transition(
       old.steps,
       new.steps,
       v_active_index,
       'approved',
       v_actor.id,
       v_actor.name
     )
     and private.finance_expense_new_files_are_owned(
       v_tenant_id,
       old,
       v_active_step -> 'files',
       new.steps -> v_active_index -> 'files',
       v_actor.id
     )
     and private.finance_expense_new_files_are_owned(
       v_tenant_id,
       old,
       old.actual_files,
       new.actual_files,
       v_actor.id
     )
     and private.finance_expense_new_files_are_owned(
       v_tenant_id,
       old,
       old.files,
       new.files,
       v_actor.id
     ) then
    v_derived_status :=
      private.finance_income_status_from_steps(new.steps);
    if new.status <> v_derived_status ->> 'approval_status'
       or new.step <> (v_derived_status ->> 'approval_step')::int then
      raise exception '採購資料送出的下一關狀態不一致'
        using errcode = '23514';
    end if;
    if v_derived_status ->> 'approval_status' = 'completed' then
      raise exception
        '申請單流程缺少最後會計入帳關卡，已停止完成；請先修正簽核路線後再處理'
        using errcode = '55000';
    end if;

    v_permission_context := pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'assignee_finance_user_id', v_actor.id,
      'owner_finance_user_id', old.applicant_id,
      'department_code', old.department_code,
      'company_id', old.entity_id,
      'entity_id', old.entity_id,
      'resource_type', 'expense_request',
      'resource_id', old.id,
      'workflow_step_key', v_role_key
    );
    if not private.finance_expense_optional_permission_allows(
      v_tenant_id,
      v_actor.id,
      'finance.approval.approve',
      v_permission_context
    ) then
      raise exception '目前人員權限不允許送出採購簽核'
        using errcode = '42501';
    end if;

    if v_role_key = 'procurement_payment' then
      v_allowed_columns := array[
        'amount',
        'estimated_amount',
        'payee',
        'bank_type',
        'bank_name',
        'bank_branch',
        'bank_no',
        'expected_pay_date',
        'bank_account',
        'fee_bearer',
        'bank_fee_amount',
        'status',
        'step',
        'steps',
        'form_payload',
        'ver',
        'updated_at'
      ];
      v_allowed_payload_keys := array[
        'purchaseEstimate',
        'procurementPaymentInfo',
        'accountingLines',
        'accountingLinesPreservedForReview',
        'accountingLinesNeedReview',
        'accountingLinesInvalidatedAt',
        'accountingLinesInvalidatedReason'
      ];
    else
      v_allowed_columns := array[
        'amount',
        'estimated_amount',
        'actual_amount',
        'actual_files',
        'files',
        'status',
        'step',
        'steps',
        'form_payload',
        'ver',
        'updated_at'
      ];
      v_allowed_payload_keys := array[
        'purchaseActual',
        'procurementReceiptInfo',
        'accountingLines',
        'accountingLinesPreservedForReview',
        'accountingLinesNeedReview',
        'accountingLinesInvalidatedAt',
        'accountingLinesInvalidatedReason'
      ];
    end if;

    if (pg_catalog.to_jsonb(new) - v_allowed_columns) <>
       (pg_catalog.to_jsonb(old) - v_allowed_columns) then
      raise exception '採購資料送出包含不允許的欄位'
        using errcode = '42501';
    end if;

    if (
         coalesce(new.form_payload, '{}'::jsonb)
         - v_allowed_payload_keys
       ) <> (
         coalesce(old.form_payload, '{}'::jsonb)
         - v_allowed_payload_keys
       )
       or (
         (
           coalesce(old.form_payload, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'accountingLinesPreservedForReview'
           or coalesce(new.form_payload, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'accountingLinesPreservedForReview'
         )
         and (new.form_payload -> 'accountingLinesPreservedForReview')
           is distinct from 'false'::jsonb
       )
       or coalesce(new.form_payload, '{}'::jsonb) ?
          'accountingLines'
       or coalesce(
         (new.form_payload ->> 'accountingLinesNeedReview')::boolean,
         false
       ) is not true
       or coalesce(
         pg_catalog.btrim(
           new.form_payload ->> 'accountingLinesInvalidatedReason'
         ),
         ''
       ) = '' then
      raise exception
        '採購資料送出只能更新本關資料並移除待重新覆核的舊會計明細'
        using errcode = '42501';
    end if;

    if v_role_key = 'procurement_payment' then
      if pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(
           new.form_payload -> 'purchaseEstimate'
         ) <> 'object'
         or pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(
           new.form_payload -> 'procurementPaymentInfo'
         ) <> 'object'
         or coalesce(new.amount, -1) <= 0
         or coalesce(new.estimated_amount, -1) <= 0
         or new.amount is distinct from new.estimated_amount
         or coalesce(
           (new.form_payload #>>
             '{procurementPaymentInfo,amount}')::numeric,
           -1
         ) <> coalesce(new.estimated_amount, new.amount, -1)
         or coalesce(
           new.form_payload #>>
             '{procurementPaymentInfo,payee}',
           ''
         ) <> coalesce(new.payee, '')
         or coalesce(
           new.form_payload #>>
             '{procurementPaymentInfo,bankType}',
           ''
         ) <> coalesce(new.bank_type, '')
         or coalesce(
           new.form_payload #>>
             '{procurementPaymentInfo,bankName}',
           ''
         ) <> coalesce(new.bank_name, '')
         or coalesce(
           new.form_payload #>>
             '{procurementPaymentInfo,bankBranch}',
           ''
         ) <> coalesce(new.bank_branch, '')
         or coalesce(
           new.form_payload #>>
             '{procurementPaymentInfo,bankNo}',
           ''
         ) <> coalesce(new.bank_no, '')
         or coalesce(
           new.form_payload #>>
             '{procurementPaymentInfo,expectedPayDate}',
           ''
         ) <> pg_catalog.replace(
           coalesce(new.expected_pay_date::text, ''),
           '/',
           '-'
         )
         or coalesce(
           new.form_payload #>>
             '{procurementPaymentInfo,feeBearer}',
           ''
         ) <> coalesce(new.fee_bearer, '')
         or coalesce(
           new.form_payload #>>
             '{procurementPaymentInfo,summary}',
           ''
         ) <> coalesce(new.bank_account, '')
         or coalesce(new.bank_fee_amount, 0) < 0
         or coalesce(
           new.form_payload #>>
             '{purchaseEstimate,stage}',
           ''
         ) <> 'procurement_estimate'
         or coalesce(
           new.form_payload #>>
             '{procurementPaymentInfo,filledBy}',
           ''
         ) <> v_actor.name then
        raise exception '總務付款資料與申請單欄位或目前處理人不一致'
          using errcode = '23514';
      end if;
    elsif pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(
            new.form_payload -> 'purchaseActual'
          ) <> 'object'
          or pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(
            new.form_payload -> 'procurementReceiptInfo'
          ) <> 'object'
          or coalesce(
            (new.form_payload #>>
              '{purchaseActual,actualAmount}')::numeric,
            -1
          ) <> coalesce(new.actual_amount, -1)
          or coalesce(new.actual_amount, -1) <= 0
          or new.amount is distinct from old.amount
          or new.estimated_amount is distinct from coalesce(
            old.estimated_amount,
            old.amount
          )
          or pg_catalog.jsonb_array_length(
            coalesce(new.actual_files, '[]'::jsonb)
          ) <= pg_catalog.jsonb_array_length(
            coalesce(old.actual_files, '[]'::jsonb)
          )
          or coalesce(
            new.form_payload #>>
              '{purchaseActual,submittedBy}',
            ''
          ) <> v_actor.name
          or coalesce(
            new.form_payload #>>
              '{purchaseActual,stage}',
            ''
          ) <> 'procurement_actual_receipt'
          or coalesce(
            (new.form_payload #>>
              '{procurementReceiptInfo,actualAmount}')::numeric,
            -1
          ) <> coalesce(new.actual_amount, -1)
          or coalesce(
            new.form_payload #>>
              '{procurementReceiptInfo,submittedBy}',
            ''
          ) <> v_actor.name
          or coalesce(
            (new.form_payload #>>
              '{procurementReceiptInfo,fileCount}')::int,
            -1
          ) <> (
            pg_catalog.jsonb_array_length(
              coalesce(new.actual_files, '[]'::jsonb)
            ) - pg_catalog.jsonb_array_length(
              coalesce(old.actual_files, '[]'::jsonb)
            )
          )
          or coalesce(
            new.form_payload -> 'purchaseActual' -> 'files',
            '[]'::jsonb
          ) <> coalesce(new.actual_files, '[]'::jsonb) then
      raise exception '採購憑據資料與實際金額、附件或目前處理人不一致'
        using errcode = '23514';
    end if;

    new.ver := coalesce(old.ver, 1) + 1;
    new.updated_at := pg_catalog.now();
    return new;
  end if;

  raise exception
    '正式申請單的簽核與會計欄位只能透過交易式功能修改'
    using errcode = '42501';
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.finance_sync_request_accounting_lines()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_lines jsonb := new.form_payload -> 'accountingLines';
  v_line jsonb;
  v_line_index integer;
  v_line_count integer := 0;
  v_old_lines jsonb := case
    when tg_op = 'UPDATE' then old.form_payload -> 'accountingLines'
    else null
  end;
begin
  if pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(v_lines) = 'array' then
    v_line_count := pg_catalog.jsonb_array_length(v_lines);
    for v_line, v_line_index in
      select line_item.value, line_item.ordinality::integer
      from pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(v_lines)
        with ordinality line_item(value, ordinality)
      order by line_item.ordinality
    loop
      insert into public.application_accounting_lines (
        id,
        request_id,
        request_no,
        line_index,
        source,
        description,
        entity_id,
        department_code,
        gross_amount,
        net_amount,
        tax_amount,
        debit_account,
        debit_account_name,
        credit_account,
        credit_account_name,
        ai_reason,
        reviewed_by,
        reviewed_at,
        payload,
        data_environment
      ) values (
        new.id || '_' || v_line_index::text,
        new.id,
        new.no,
        v_line_index,
        coalesce(v_line ->> 'source', 'detail'),
        coalesce(v_line ->> 'description', ''),
        new.entity_id,
        coalesce(v_line ->> 'departmentCode', new.department_code),
        coalesce((v_line ->> 'grossAmount')::numeric, 0),
        coalesce((v_line ->> 'netAmount')::numeric, 0),
        coalesce((v_line ->> 'taxAmount')::numeric, 0),
        coalesce(v_line ->> 'debitAccount', ''),
        coalesce(v_line ->> 'debitAccountName', ''),
        coalesce(v_line ->> 'creditAccount', ''),
        coalesce(v_line ->> 'creditAccountName', ''),
        coalesce(v_line ->> 'aiReason', ''),
        coalesce(v_line ->> 'reviewedBy', ''),
        nullif(v_line ->> 'reviewedAt', '')::timestamptz,
        v_line,
        coalesce(new.data_environment, 'production')
      )
      on conflict (request_id, line_index) do update set
        request_no = excluded.request_no,
        source = excluded.source,
        description = excluded.description,
        entity_id = excluded.entity_id,
        department_code = excluded.department_code,
        gross_amount = excluded.gross_amount,
        net_amount = excluded.net_amount,
        tax_amount = excluded.tax_amount,
        debit_account = excluded.debit_account,
        debit_account_name = excluded.debit_account_name,
        credit_account = excluded.credit_account,
        credit_account_name = excluded.credit_account_name,
        ai_reason = excluded.ai_reason,
        reviewed_by = excluded.reviewed_by,
        reviewed_at = excluded.reviewed_at,
        payload = excluded.payload,
        data_environment = excluded.data_environment,
        updated_at = pg_catalog.now();
    end loop;
  end if;

  delete from public.application_accounting_lines accounting_line
  where accounting_line.request_id = new.id
    and accounting_line.line_index > v_line_count;

  if v_lines is distinct from v_old_lines
     and pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(v_lines) = 'array'
     and exists (
       select 1
       from pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(v_lines) line_item(value)
       where private.finance_accounting_line_is_human(line_item.value)
     ) then
    insert into public.module_audit_logs (
      table_name,
      row_id,
      action,
      actor_email,
      before_data,
      after_data
    ) values (
      'application_accounting_lines',
      new.id,
      'HUMAN_ACCOUNTING_SYNC',
      auth.jwt() ->> 'email',
      v_old_lines,
      v_lines
    );
  end if;

  return new;
end;
